text.title: DORA + Reliability Metrics Report Worked Example
text.summary: One worked example end-to-end for dora-metrics — narrative trace plus the final artefact. Concrete examples of deployment event emission, PromQL queries for DORA metrics, and lead time calculation in Python.

section.title: Narrative trace
section.p: Operator triggers the methodology with a real task signal. Decision tree confirms preconditions hold. Inputs gathered per Prerequisites. Template filled, validator run, artefact committed and monitoring wired. The artefact below conforms to content/02-output-contract.xml.

example.note: See `templates/backup-config.example.json` for the schema-conformant filled artefact.
GitHub Actions step emitting a deployment event after successful deploy.
example.code: - name: Record Deployment Event if: success() run: | curl -X POST "$METRICS_ENDPOINT/events/deployment" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.DORA_API_KEY }}" \ -d '{ "service": "${{ github.repository }}", "environment": "production", "commit_sha": "${{ github.sha }}", "commit_timestamp": "${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}", "deployed_at": "'$(date -Iseconds)'", "is_rollback": false, "is_hotfix": false }'

example.note: Recording deployment at pipeline start — will emit even if deploy fails, inflating DF.
example.code: - name: Record Deployment (wrong placement) run: | curl -X POST "$METRICS_ENDPOINT/events/deployment" ... ./deploy.sh # deploy happens AFTER recording — wrong
